harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-22: borg-reborn-rs request (RULES 20), filed as borg-zoo#649; zoo owner, 2026-11-22: "yes do them" (the pilot only; small + medium after the gate and the owner).
experiment.prespecified:
Pilot (classes-18, 2 starts per class, 300,000 turns): the gate is that no cell has a config_error and every game
ends in death or at the cap. Everything is directional; a claim needs a fresh seed block (RULES 14). Pairs: save2
against ctl, save2-noov against ctl and against save2 (the overrides). Primary measures, fixed here, per class:
(1) flasks of oil thrown per game, adjacent and at range; (2) flasks carried at each town departure and return, and
games that run out of light fuel or flasks; (3) deaths, with rescued and newly killed pairs against ctl, and deaths
within 20 turns of a fight where a flask was saved; (4) HP lost per kill and turns per kill against monsters the
shipped Borg throws at; (5) mean max CL and depth, and alive at the cap.
